author: Ezno
body:
Although threads like this are getting old, I just got a new mouse, so lets keep these going!
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This thread should mainly include pictures and links, just like old times. 
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
How this works:
Post a picture or link of your computer mouse
Picture dosn't have to be an IRL picture, it could be found on the web
I suggest using imgur.com
Please include mouse brand and or name
And more importantly, NO PICTURES OF ACTUAL MOUSES!
-------------
Have fun! 

http://imgur.com/i9yiZQu
Razer Deathadder Chroma 2015
